sources.note: Nothing. Ch. 5 'The Distribution of Complexity in Handshape Inventories: Phonology in Homesign' (pp. 132-172) treats handshape complexity via Brentari's Prosodic Model (a handshape feature geometry); there is no section on prosody, stress, accent or rhythm, and a full-text search for stress/accent/prosod/suprasegment/intonation returns only the Prosodic Model and unrelated hits. Word stress is not a category of this manual homesign system.
